title: Pass 3 reference table: reduced hollow-spine self-contact closure and predator-damage / mantle-repair perturbations for 2013-chirat-mollusc-shell-marginal-buckling.py
scope_note: Both Pass 2 remediation items are closed with reduced-order models, not a full 3D finite-strain morphoelastic shell FEM (Rudraraju et al. 2019). The spine is a planar inextensible Euler elastica cross-section with a self-contact penalty; the damage/repair perturbation is a heterogeneous-foundation Winkler beam with template memory along an accretionary station sequence. The residual (true 3D FE shell + volumetric growth tensor) is carried as a Pass 4 item.

sources.use: hollow spine as a folded mantle margin; antimarginal rib wavelength law
planar elastica / Kirchhoff rod reduction of the growing mantle edge
3D morphoelastic FEM framework the reduced spine model approximates (residual)

sources.citation: Vermeij GJ (1987). Evolution and Escalation: An Ecological History of Life. Princeton University Press. ISBN 978-0-691-08446-6.
sources.use: durophagous predation, marginal shell breakage and repair scars (book; DOI not verifiable offline)

hollow_spine_cross_section_elastica.model: U[theta] = 0.5*EI*sum((dtheta/ds)^2) ds + 0.5*mu_clamp*(theta_0^2 + theta_M^2) + 0.5*mu_end*(|x_M - W|^2 + y_M^2) + 0.25*mu_contact*sum_{|i-j|>M/5} (t - d_ij)_+^2
hollow_spine_cross_section_elastica.arc_length_law: L = W * (1 + eps), eps = mantle growth excess of the spine fold
hollow_spine_cross_section_elastica.small_strain_amplitude_law: A_lin = (2/pi) * sqrt(W * (L - W))  [clamped first mode w = (A/2)(1 - cos(2 pi s / W))]

reference_values.note: Closure threshold reference is a mesh-convergence reference from the same model at M = 224 segments (threshold lies in (4.8, 5.0] for all resolutions); no independent published value for the closure strain of a Murex spine fold is vendored.

predator_damage_mantle_repair.model: E I w_ssss + P w_ss + k(s) w + kappa_3 w^3 = 0 with k(s) = k * (1 + (rho - 1) * chi_sector(s) * exp(-(r - r_d)/l_heal)); template memory w_init(r_i) = w_eq(r_{i-1}) * A_eq(r_i)/A_eq(r_{i-1}); chipped sector w_init = 0
predator_damage_mantle_repair.local_critical_load_law: P_c,loc = 2*sqrt(E I k(s)) = sqrt(rho) * P_c in the fresh callus

reference_values.critical_chip_heuristic_note: A template gap wider than ~1.5 lambda_c can host one more crest than it lost (half-integer rounding heuristic); it is a heuristic, not a published value. Numerically the transition at rho = 1 lies between chip/lambda = 1.53 and 1.97 on the vendored grid.
reference_values.healing_length_consistency_note: The exponential fit of the scar index Delta(r) is compared to the imposed callus decay length l_heal = 7 mm as a model-consistency check, not an independent empirical value.
